forCodingAgent: Copy each sourceFile into the application at its matching publicPath. Preserve the original upload until the copy is confirmed.
Use publicPath as the website asset URL and certificate image/PDF link.
Render image certificates as thumbnails with a click-to-view or modal preview. For PDF certificates, show a preview or document link and open the PDF in a new tab.
Use title, issuer, summary, category, and skillsCovered for the certification card content.
Show credential ID, issue date, expiry date, and verification link only when a value exists.
A QR code visible on a certificate is not a verified URL. Do not invent a verification URL; allow the portfolio admin to add one later.
Do not call a certificate verified solely because an ID or QR code appears on the certificate. Use verificationStatus = unknown unless verification was independently completed.
Store these records in Supabase and make them editable through the existing admin dashboard. Keep sourceFile and publicPath so assets remain traceable.
integrationInstructions.missingValuePolicy: Use null for details not visible in the supplied certificate. Do not infer dates, expiry, issuer, URLs, or credential IDs.
